sparse_age_summary.scope: Sparse health snapshots only; neither per-frame distribution nor expired-time fraction

observer.stop_rule: CPU read >0.5ms; wall read >2ms if CPU clock missing; low-CPU late wall reads stay flagged
observer.scope: calling thread switch counts only; cannot time CPU runqueue or identify GIL/native root cause
observer.observer_cost_scope: original optional hard cap includes all observation work; never subtracted
